		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_kind value = flag:turncoat }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_kind_t_secret_clause = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}
	is_valid = {
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		exists = scope:actor.house
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			OR = {
				any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
				any_close_family_member = {
					OR = {
						any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
						betrothed.house ?= scope:actor.house
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_t_kind = flag:secret_clause } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_t_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_kind value = flag:secret_clause }

	}

		scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
		scope:actor = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom }
	}
	is_valid = {
		scope:recipient = {
			qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

		scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
		scope:actor = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom }
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_t_kind = flag:pliant_patriarch } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_t_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_kind value = flag:pliant_patriarch }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_land_clear_t = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_ui_t_land }
			clear_variable_list = qpq_ui_t_land
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_config_t = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			qpq_ui_leg_t_needs_char_trigger = yes
			qpq_ui_leg_t_needs_title_trigger = yes
			qpq_ui_leg_t_needs_artifact_trigger = yes
			qpq_ui_leg_t_has_extra_qpq_x_armed_trigger = yes
			qpq_ui_leg_t_has_extra_qpq_x_consent_trigger = yes
			qpq_ui_leg_t_has_extra_qpq_x_armies_trigger = yes
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_land_toggle_t = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { qpq_pick }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_list = qpq_ui_t_land
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_land target = scope:qpq_pick }
			}
			remove_list_variable = { name = qpq_ui_t_land target = scope:qpq_pick }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_t_land target = scope:qpq_pick }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_list = qpq_ui_t_land
				variable_list_size = { name = qpq_ui_t_land value > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land }
				remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_land
			}
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_t_church_favours = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

				scope:recipient.faith = {
					OR = {
						qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes
						has_doctrine = doctrine_divorce_approval
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:recipient.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_spiritual_head }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } scope:recipient.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

				scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_sunni_doctrine }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

				scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
				scope:actor = {
					is_independent_ruler = no
					top_liege = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

				scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
				scope:actor = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
					faith = scope:actor.faith
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						this = scope:actor.realm_priest
					}
				}
				scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_pagan }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
					faith = scope:actor.faith
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						this = scope:actor.realm_priest
					}
				}
				scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_eastern }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
					faith = scope:actor.faith
					OR = {
						is_clergy = yes
						government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy
					}
				}
				NOT = { exists = scope:actor.faith.religious_head }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_t_church_weapons = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:recipient.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:recipient.faith = { suitable_faith_for_any_ghw_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county } scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_temporal_head }
			}
			AND = {
				has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
				scope:recipient = {
					exists = clerical_elector_title
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			}
			AND = {
				has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
				scope:recipient = {
					is_clergy = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:recipient = {
					is_landed = yes
					is_independent_ruler = no
					exists = liege
				}

				scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
				scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
					religion = religion:islam_religion
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						AND = {
							is_clergy = yes
							learning >= 15
						}
					}
				}
				scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
			}
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					NOT = { this = scope:actor }
					faith = scope:actor.faith
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						AND = { is_clergy = yes learning >= 12 }
					}
				}
				scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_shia_doctrine }
			}
		}
	}
}

			remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_artifact
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_artifact
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_t_church = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_t_allows_church_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_church
			AND = {
				scope:actor = { qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes } }
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_church }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_church
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_t_o_church
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		always = yes

		scope:actor = {
			liege ?= scope:recipient

		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_kind value = flag:chartered_conquest }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes

qpq_ui_kind_i_clemency_bargain = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}
	is_valid = {
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_imprisoned_by = scope:actor
			}
			any_known_secret = {
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:recipient }
				NOT = { secret_owner = scope:actor }
				NOT = { is_known_by = scope:actor }
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:clemency_bargain } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_i_effect = yes
		}

	}

qpq_ui_kind_i_electoral_capitulation = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}
	is_valid = {
		exists = scope:recipient.primary_title
		scope:recipient.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = scope:actor } }
		NOT = { scope:actor = scope:recipient }
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:electoral_capitulation } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_i_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_kind value = flag:electoral_capitulation }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}

qpq_ui_kind_i_mutual_defense_league = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}
	is_valid = {
		scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:actor = {
			is_landed = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
		}
		exists = scope:recipient.liege
		scope:recipient.liege = scope:actor.liege
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:mutual_defense_league } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_i_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_kind value = flag:mutual_defense_league }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}
	is_valid = {
		NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

		exists = scope:recipient.house
		scope:actor = {
			is_landed = yes
			OR = {
				any_spouse = { house ?= scope:recipient.house }
				any_close_family_member = {
					OR = {
						any_spouse = { house ?= scope:recipient.house }
						betrothed.house ?= scope:recipient.house
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:secret_clause } }

		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_kind value = flag:secret_clause }

qpq_ui_kind_i_council_lobbying = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
		scope:actor = {
			is_clergy = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
		scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
	}
	is_valid = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_clergy = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
		}
		scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
		scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:council_lobbying } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_i_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_kind value = flag:council_lobbying }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }

qpq_ui_kind_i_name_in_the_khutba = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

		scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:actor = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_independent_ruler = no
			exists = liege
		}

		scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
		scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
	}
	is_valid = {
		NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

		scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
		scope:actor = {
			is_landed = yes
			is_independent_ruler = no
			exists = liege
		}

		scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
		scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:name_in_the_khutba } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_i_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_kind value = flag:name_in_the_khutba }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_kind_i_fatwa_for_hire = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			religion = religion:islam_religion
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				AND = {
					is_clergy = yes
					learning >= 15
				}
			}
		}
		scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
	}
	is_valid = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			religion = religion:islam_religion
			OR = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				AND = {
					is_clergy = yes
					learning >= 15
				}
			}
		}
		scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:qpq_ui_i_kind = flag:fatwa_for_hire } }
			qpq_ui_clear_leg_i_effect = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_kind value = flag:fatwa_for_hire }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {

			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			faith = scope:recipient.faith
			OR = {
				is_clergy = yes
				government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy
			}
		}
		NOT = { exists = scope:recipient.faith.religious_head }

	is_valid = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
			faith = scope:recipient.faith
			OR = {
				is_clergy = yes
				government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy
			}
		}
		NOT = { exists = scope:recipient.faith.religious_head }

qpq_ui_gold_add_i = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_land_clear_i = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_land }
			clear_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_land
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_config_i = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			qpq_ui_leg_i_needs_char_trigger = yes
			qpq_ui_leg_i_needs_title_trigger = yes
			qpq_ui_leg_i_needs_artifact_trigger = yes
			qpq_ui_leg_i_has_extra_qpq_x_armed_trigger = yes
			qpq_ui_leg_i_has_extra_qpq_x_consent_trigger = yes
			qpq_ui_leg_i_has_extra_qpq_x_armies_trigger = yes
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_land_toggle_i = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { qpq_pick }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_land
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_land target = scope:qpq_pick }
			}
			remove_list_variable = { name = qpq_ui_i_land target = scope:qpq_pick }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = qpq_ui_i_land target = scope:qpq_pick }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_list = qpq_ui_i_land
				variable_list_size = { name = qpq_ui_i_land value > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }
				remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
			}
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_i_church_favours = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith

				scope:actor.faith = {
					OR = {
						qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes
						has_doctrine = doctrine_divorce_approval
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:actor.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_spiritual_head }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } scope:actor.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith

				scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_sunni_doctrine }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith

				scope:actor.faith = faith:orthodox
				scope:recipient = {
					is_independent_ruler = no
					top_liege = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith

				scope:actor.faith = faith:orthodox
				scope:recipient = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					faith = scope:recipient.faith
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						this = scope:recipient.realm_priest
					}
				}
				scope:recipient.religion = { is_in_family = rf_pagan }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					faith = scope:recipient.faith
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						this = scope:recipient.realm_priest
					}
				}
				scope:recipient.religion = { is_in_family = rf_eastern }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					faith = scope:recipient.faith
					OR = {
						is_clergy = yes
						government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy
					}
				}
				NOT = { exists = scope:recipient.faith.religious_head }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_group_i_church_weapons = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:actor.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:actor.faith = { suitable_faith_for_any_ghw_trigger = yes }
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
				scope:actor = { is_landed = yes highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county } scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_temporal_head }
			}
			AND = {
				has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
				scope:actor = {
					exists = clerical_elector_title
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			}
			AND = {
				has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
				scope:actor = {
					is_clergy = yes
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
				}
				scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
				scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			}
			AND = {
				NOT = { scope:actor.top_liege = scope:recipient.top_liege }

				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					is_landed = yes
					is_independent_ruler = no
					exists = liege
				}

				scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
				scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					religion = religion:islam_religion
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						AND = {
							is_clergy = yes
							learning >= 15
						}
					}
				}
				scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
			}
			AND = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					faith = scope:recipient.faith
					OR = {
						qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
						AND = { is_clergy = yes learning >= 12 }
					}
				}
				scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_shia_doctrine }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_i_gold = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_gold_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
			AND = {
				always = yes
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_gold
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_i_land = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_land_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = { any_held_title = { tier = tier_county count >= 2 } }
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_land
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_i_office = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_office_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_office
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				scope:actor = {
					OR = {
						liege ?= scope:recipient
						is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
					}
					NOT = { is_councillor_of = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_office }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_office
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_office
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_i_marriage = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_marriage_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_marriage
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = { any_close_family_member = { is_married = no NOT = { exists = betrothed } is_alive = yes } }
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_marriage }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_marriage
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_marriage
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_i_secret = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_secret_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_secret
			AND = {
				scope:recipient = {
					any_known_secret = {
						NOT = { secret_owner = scope:actor }
						NOT = { is_known_by = scope:actor }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_secret }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_secret
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_secret
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_i_succession = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_succession_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_succession
			AND = {
				scope:actor = { is_child_of = scope:recipient } NOT = { scope:recipient.primary_heir ?= scope:actor }
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_succession }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_succession
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_succession
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_i_clemency = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_leg_i_allows_clemency_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_clemency
			AND = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { is_imprisoned_by = scope:recipient }
					scope:recipient = { any_prisoner = { is_close_family_of = scope:actor } }
					scope:recipient = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:actor modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_clemency }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_clemency
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_i_o_clemency
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
